title: Best of Bali with Flights and Nusa Penida
alt: Cliffs above Kelingking beach on Nusa Penida, Bali
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Legian hotel with a rooftop pool, ten minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Water sports, Uluwatu and the Kecak dance
activities.description: Parasailing, jet ski and a banana boat at Tanjung Benoa, then Uluwatu temple at sunset and the Kecak fire dance in the cliff amphitheatre.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast with snorkelling
activities.description: Speedboat across for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach, with snorkelling and a local lunch included.

activities.name: Kuta beach and Legian
activities.description: The long surf beach below Legian, with boards and lessons on the sand, and beach bars that stay busy until the sun drops.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Four nights in Legian with a water sports and Uluwatu day, a full island day on Nusa Penida and a free day on the beach.

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Villa resort in the rice fields west of Ubud town

activities.name: Kintamani highlands tour
activities.description: The Mount Batur viewpoint, a coffee plantation tasting, Tegenungan waterfall and a turn on the Bali jungle swing on the way to Ubud.

activities.name: Ubud Monkey Forest
activities.description: Banyan trees, moss covered shrines and a few hundred macaques in a sanctuary ten minutes on foot from the Ubud market.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights in a rice field villa to finish, reached by way of the Kintamani highlands, with a free day for the town and its temples.

1: Flight from Delhi to Denpasar, included in your package
Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Legian hotel and settle in
Rest of the day free near the beach

Parasailing, jet ski and a banana boat with an instructor
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
Kecak fire dance in the temple amphitheatre afterwards
3: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach
Snorkelling and a local lunch before the boat back
4: Breakfast and a full day free on the coast
Optional: a surf lesson with an instructor on Kuta beach
Optional: Beachwalk mall or the Legian bars in the evening
Optional: a spa afternoon near the hotel
5: Breakfast and check out, then north through the highlands
Mount Batur viewpoint and a coffee plantation tasting
Tegenungan waterfall and the Bali jungle swing
Check in at your villa in the Ubud rice fields
6: Breakfast and a full day free in Ubud
Optional: the Monkey Forest and the Saraswati water temple
Optional: the art market and the palace in the town centre
Optional: a cooking class or a yoga session at the villa
7: Breakfast at the villa and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your return flight

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Flights, a four star beach hotel and a rice field villa in one price. This is the package I send most often.
expert.tip: Four nights on the coast means you can split the island days with a lazy one in between. Ask for a rooftop pool room in Legian and a garden villa in Ubud when we confirm.

summary: Seven days with return flights included: four nights in Legian for water sports, Uluwatu at sunset and a full day on Nusa Penida with snorkelling, then two nights in a rice field villa near Ubud by way of the Kintamani highlands.
included: Included: return flights from Delhi; 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; water sports with Uluwatu and the Kecak dance; Nusa Penida west coast tour with snorkelling and lunch; Kintamani highlands tour.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners other than the one stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
